title: Add admin endpoint to delete a product
body:
## Summary

Adds DELETE /api/products/:id so admins can remove products from the catalog.

## Changes

* products.remove
* DELETE route

## How to test

Login as admin and DELETE /api/products/6.

verixa_should_cover: Customer must get 403 (BUG: any logged in user can delete)
Cart that already holds the deleted product must still load (BUG: cart returns 404)
